response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile is a poor match for this role's mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus a university thesis project — far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++, and none of it on a Windows-centric enterprise stack in recent years. Database experience is centered on MongoDB and MySQL rather than SQL Server or Oracle. Financial-domain exposure is limited to a German investment-platform startup (RIDE Capital) built in Node/TypeScript, which does not constitute fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking systems experience. The recent career trajectory (TypeScript, Node.js, AI tooling, D language) points away from this role rather than toward it.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience across web, desktop, and embedded systems
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby plus excellent communication evidenced by talks and workshops
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago; no recent Windows C++ work
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; databases used are MongoDB and MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking/capital-markets domain background
